Target files: hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.test.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/runtime.test.ts. Some hosts (e.g. the Claude desktop app) put a `<system-reminder>` block before the user's words in the prompt. The prompt hook used it as-is, so the recall query (cut to ~1,000 chars from the start) and the reflect goal were mostly host boilerplate. (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6491)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: 书签目标写在 /A /GoTo 动作中的 PDF 全部无法解析，章节结构丢失
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pdf): 解析写在 /A /GoTo 动作中的书签目标. Target files: openviking/parse/parsers/pdf.py, tests/parse/test_pdf_bookmark_extraction.py. 本地导入 PDF 时，书签会用来生成章节。之前解析器只读取书签的 `/Dest`；若同一目标写在 `/A << /S /GoTo /D [...] >>`，正文仍能提取，但该书签无法定位页码，因此不能生成对应章节。 (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7077)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with vLLM for GRPO structured outputs: AssertionError: Parameter model.layers.1.self_attn.k_proj.bias has not changed.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Require top_k for GRPO structured outputs with the vLLM importance sampling correction. Target files: trl/trainer/grpo_config.py, trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes GRPO with vLLM structured outputs and the importance sampling correction require `top_k > 0`, so that the trainer normalizes its log-probs over the tokens the grammar allows. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8145)

workarounds.symptom: xAI grok-4.7 compression no-ops on encrypted reasoning, then structural_backoff blocks retry

workarounds.symptom: [Serve] FastAPI based deployment doesn't respect ASGI scope state.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [serve] Copy the ASGI lifespan state into each request scope. Target files: python/ray/serve/_private/http_util.py, python/ray/serve/tests/test_fastapi.py, python/ray/serve/tests/unit/test_http_util.py. A FastAPI app or ASGI middleware that stores resources in its lifespan state can't read them from a request in Ray Serve. Under plain FastAPI plus uvicorn, each request's `scope["state"]` holds a shallow copy of the lifespan state, as the [ASGI lifespan state spec](https://asgi.readthedocs.io/en/latest/specs/lifespan.html#li... (Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/pull/67844)
